ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
WetlandMapper operationalises two peer-reviewed remote-sensing frameworks:
(1) basin-scale wetland detection and 6-class temporal dynamics classification
from MNDWI time series (Singh & Sinha 2022, Remote Sensing Letters), and
(2) Wetland Cover Type classification using MNDWI, NDVI, and NDTI
(Singh et al. 2022, Environmental Monitoring and Assessment).
Data can be supplied by the user or fetched from Google Earth Engine.
about.summary: Automatic wetland mapping, dynamics classification, and Wetland Cover Type characterisation from multispectral time-series data.

name: wetlandmapper
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "wetlandmapper" %}
{% set version = "1.2.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5465ed7b0642e3fc231ef0f4e0bf255c76f3c701d87b3adf17ce47fcd1caf268

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools >=68
    - setuptools-scm >=8

  run:
    - python >{{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.24
    - xarray >=2023.1
    - rioxarray >=0.15

test:
  imports:
    - wetlandmapper
    - wetlandmapper.indices
    - wetlandmapper.dynamics
    - wetlandmapper.wct
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip

about:
  home: https://github.com/manudeo/wetlandmapper
  summary: >-
    Automatic wetland mapping, dynamics classification, and Wetland Cover Type characterisation from multispectral time-series data.
  description: |
    WetlandMapper operationalises two peer-reviewed remote-sensing frameworks:
    (1) basin-scale wetland detection and 6-class temporal dynamics classification
    from MNDWI time series (Singh & Sinha 2022, Remote Sensing Letters), and
    (2) Wetland Cover Type classification using MNDWI, NDVI, and NDTI
    (Singh et al. 2022, Environmental Monitoring and Assessment).
    Data can be supplied by the user or fetched from Google Earth Engine.
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_family: GPL3
  license_file: LICENSE
  doc_url: https://wetlandmapper.readthedocs.io
  dev_url: https://github.com/manudeo/wetlandmapper

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - manudeo
